purpose: Independently test where a 9B hybrid model stores two revised country assignments before any question arrives. The original four-row attention transplant passed its pilot criterion. The learned donor-free transport failed its development condition. Its reserved confirmation remains unused. This study confirms a component-localization hypothesis and tests an executable query-redirection baseline; it does not promote the discarded transport estimator.
cohort: 32 unused public CAPITALS prompt IDs 75219000..75219031. For each, render the authors' original DEFAULT and WORK templates with three people, apply the known country transposition from the pilot and issue three separate capital queries, including all 128 changed and 64 stable presentations. Check complete document hashes against all exposed development and calibration documents and the previously reserved candidate IDs before any held-out inference. No exclusion by answer or confidence. Fixed original data revision, Qwen 9B 4-bit checkpoint, tokenizer and free whole-vocabulary top-token metric.
modes: Old and full updated document; all donor recurrent/convolution states only; donor attention K/V at the two changed countries and their punctuation (four positions in every full-attention layer); donor values at those same positions; donor K/V at the four positions with the largest aggregate squared K/V change across layers/heads, either unrestricted, or excluding the four changed-country/punctuation positions; a textual correction appended to the old document; query redirection on the old cache using the known entity permutation. Redirect the queried name in both occurrences of the original official question, leave the stable subject alone and execute the actual model with that query. No lookup of capitals for redirection. Report how often the unrestricted selector chooses the lexical rows. All donor-based interventions share a fully updated cache and cannot establish serving speed.
inference: Resample whole prompt IDs (two templates and three questions stay together) 10000 times, seed 684722. Primary comparison is local K/V vs all recurrent cache on changed answers. Confirm if local K/V retains at least 90% of full replay's correct changed answers, gains >=25 percentage points in changed accuracy vs recurrent-only with lower 95% paired CI above zero, and loses <=2 previously correct stable answers. Report per-question wins and losses against full, redirection, both other four-row selection controls, and value-only. Report conditional and unconditional counts. No requirement or claim of beating the structured text baseline. Report an exact-input check for every redirected inference and stable query.
budget: Local M5 only. No calibration, early stop, parameter tuning, paid credits or open-ended question claims. At most 20 minutes plus one engineering repair. Include a successful mechanistic result in the four-page paper if the gate passes, with the strongest simple comparator and the donor-access qualification.
